description: Patterns that are NOT reliable AI indicators - avoid false accusations
warning: These patterns should NOT be used for AI detection as they commonly appear in human writing

patterns.reason: Skilled human writers exist and produce grammatically correct text
patterns.note: Do NOT flag perfect grammar as AI indicator

patterns.reason: LLMs are actually effusive and florid, not bland. Bland writing is often human.
patterns.note: Do NOT flag monotonous or dry prose as AI

patterns.reason: LLMs favor statistically common words. Unusual vocabulary is often human.
patterns.note: Do NOT flag sophisticated vocabulary as AI

patterns.reason: Formal style is common in business and academic human writing
patterns.note: Do NOT flag formal tone as AI indicator

patterns.reason: Conjunctions (and, but, or) are standard in all writing
patterns.note: Do NOT flag conjunction usage as AI

patterns.reason: AI models prefer high-frequency common words due to training statistics
patterns.note: Unusual or rare words suggest human authorship

patterns.reason: Both AI and humans can write long, complex sentences
patterns.note: Sentence length alone is not an indicator

patterns.reason: Both AI and humans use short sentences for emphasis
patterns.note: Sentence length alone is not an indicator

patterns.reason: Lists are common in human documentation and communication
patterns.note: Format alone is not an indicator

patterns.reason: Numbered lists are standard in human technical and instructional writing
patterns.note: Format alone is not an indicator

context_specific_notes.note: Technical terms like 'ecosystem', 'leverage', 'robust' may be legitimate
context_specific_notes.guidance: Verify if term is used in proper technical context before flagging

context_specific_notes.note: Formal language and complex vocabulary are expected
Promotional language may be intentional, not AI-generated
context_specific_notes.guidance: Consider whether promotional tone matches content purpose

context_specific_notes.note: Metaphors like 'tapestry' and 'landscape' may be stylistic choices
context_specific_notes.guidance: Literary devices should not be automatically flagged

detection_accuracy_notes.recommendation: Use multiple indicators, never rely on single pattern

important_caveats: These are POTENTIAL signs, not definitive proof
Many patterns existed in human writing before LLMs
False accusations harm collaboration and trust
Context matters - consider the full picture
Do NOT solely rely on AI detection tools
When in doubt, assume human authorship
Focus on DEFINITIVE markers (technical artifacts) for high confidence
